Historical tiny work-budget REDs and the rejected large-pair outcome are required to stay false; the two tiny REDs are arithmetically checked and bound to actual successful whole-write observations and all their captured outputs.

Both accepted v2 legs must have all ten producer-bound outputs, exact within-leg raw mesh facts, common compiled native pin maps, the exact baseline execution reference, equal native request bytes and deck bytes differing only in one specified timestamp comment.
Across-process group normalization is confined to unique name/type records and exact ordered memberships; native group-handle order and all other snapshot fields remain exact.
The complete 132-bay witness schema, native binary, frozen fixture/oracle hashes, 3566 unique physical checks, unchanged 1%/5% limits and vector error arithmetic are checked directly.

The exact synthetic capsule has an explicit allow-list of leaf names, individually root-approved source/SHA/size records, unchanged original hashes, witness-retained-file bindings, exact saved fixture hashes, five literal cold native source paths and the actual 2113 applied capacity echo.

Opaque profiler bytes are never unmarshalled and must be receipt-bound own output; public FCStd/FRD copies require the individually approved exact synthetic capsule and do not grant a broad isolated-TEMP namespace exception.

Copied paths exclude symlinks, profile/config/cache/vendor namespaces, runtime binary suffixes and native binary magic. JSON payloads reject raw environment, credential and preservation-inventory structures.

All explicit payload bytes are captured once, descriptor-checked, end-fenced before writes and after publication, deterministically gzipped where selected and indexed with original/stored/decoded byte counts and hashes.

Both publication destinations must be new. Destination canonicalization, transformed-name collisions and file/directory prefix collisions are rejected. Check-only reaches all semantic/privacy/cap/end-fence checks without writing.

Both the initial payload cap and the final index/summary-inclusive uncompressed packet cap refuse before publication. The fixed 128 MiB per-file and 256 MiB packet limits cannot silently be increased in a plan.
The final summary explicitly requires a separate independent post-publication audit and makes no installation, engineering-project, R49/R51, timing-SLA or universal-scaling acceptance claim.

Inspect each selected text/log/source payload and the exact generic FCStd/FRD capsule approval for privacy. Structure/magic checks supplement explicit root file selection; they are not a universal secret scanner.

Calculate the actual exact plan aggregate including index/summary before approval. If the complete evidence exceeds 256 MiB, approve only a separately reviewed explicit collector revision and matching exact plan; do not omit defining evidence or alias different original paths.

No final plan, fresh physics run, final build/full suites, cold execution, actual source qualification or publication is approved by this static review. A separate independent exact stored/decoded/index/coverage audit remains required after publication.
